statement: A rule of the standard in blocking whose check is a gate stage names a stage tower/gate runs: a stage scripts/lib/verify_commit.py skips (SKIPPED) makes the rule an error of scripts/model check until it is dormant or the stage runs again.
note: Written with D-326 ("scripts/model refuses a blocking gate-stage rule whose stage verify_commit skips"); it refuses through STD-model-complete: the model test, which the gate selects when a file it reads changes, holds the model at no error.
